senses.definition: A region around a world where its magnetic field traps fast-moving electrically charged particles.
senses.example: Explorer 1 helped scientists discover a radiation belt surrounding Earth.

senses.definition: A vehicle made to travel along the surface of the Moon.
senses.example: The astronauts used a lunar rover to carry samples back to their lander from several places.

senses.definition: A spacecraft that stays in space and provides a place for people to do work and live for a while.
senses.example: Three crews visited the Skylab space station.

senses.definition: An instrument in space that gathers light or other waves to study distant objects.
senses.example: The space telescope could look for planets passing across stars.

senses.definition: A planet passing in front of its star as seen by someone or something watching from far away.
senses.example: The planetary transit blocked a little of the star’s light.

senses.definition: A trip that gathers a small amount of material from another place in space and brings it back to Earth.
senses.example: The Hayabusa2 sample return gave researchers small pieces of an asteroid.

senses.definition: The side of the Moon that usually faces away from Earth.
senses.example: A satellite passed messages from a lander on the lunar far side back to Earth.
